events.name: Maia Chess Open 2026 (Maia International Chess Festival)
events.location: TECMAIA, R. Eng. Frederico Ulrich 2650, 4470-605 Maia (~15km from Porto)
events.price: From €60 entry fee (tiered by registration date; GM/IM/WGM/WIM free)
events.description: International Swiss-system chess tournament (9 rounds) with Masters (2000+) and U2000 divisions, part of the wider Maia Chess Festival which also includes a Douro Blitz Cruise and masterclasses.
events.interest_rate_reason: Competitive chess tournament has no clear match to any positive story (not business-networking, adrenaline, craft, or live-music), so the score stays low despite legitimate organization.

events.name: Experimentar Pinturas – Oficina Sensorial para Bebés
events.description: Sensory painting session at Oficina Josefina designed for infants and their caregivers to explore texture, color and touch together.
events.interest_rate_reason: Sensory workshop designed for infant participation, not the requester's own hands-on experience — no meaningful match to any positive story dimension.
